style: cute chibi character for a children's chess game, chunky rounded proportions, big head, small body, thick clean dark outline, flat pastel colours with soft cel shading, 2D sticker illustration, full body, plain pure white background

poses.attack: leaning forward and casting a sparkly magic spell towards the right side, one arm stretched out to the right, determined happy face, dynamic action pose, facing right
poses.hit: just hit by a puff of magic sparkles, recoiling backwards, dizzy swirly eyes, little stars circling above the head, surprised round mouth, leaning back
poses.victory: jumping with joy, both arms raised high in the air, big happy smile, eyes closed laughing

rook.attack: tilting forward towards the right side and shooting a stream of sparkles from its top battlements, determined happy face, dynamic action pose, facing right
rook.victory: hopping up with joy on its tiny wheels, little flags waving from the battlements, big happy smile, eyes closed laughing

knight.attack: rearing up on its hind legs facing right, front hooves kicking out a puff of sparkles, determined happy face, dynamic action pose
knight.victory: prancing happily with all four hooves off the ground, mane flowing, big happy smile, eyes closed laughing
